"""Bizlog wrapper with safe fallback to standard logging.

Uses bizlog when available and falls back to stdlib logging otherwise.

Ported from the berichtskonfigurator repo and adapted for dokumentenpruefung.
The wrapper standardises INFO+ log records to the service name
``dokumentenpruefung`` and redacts sensitive identifiers/paths/URLs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from collections.abc import Callable
from hashlib import sha256
from inspect import signature
from typing import cast

try:
    from bizlog import (
        get_bizlog_logger as _raw_bizlog_get_logger,  # type: ignore[import-not-found]
    )

    _BizlogCallable = Callable[..., logging.Logger]
    _BizlogNoArgCallable = Callable[..., logging.Logger]

    try:
        _BIZLOG_SUPPORTS_NAME = len(signature(_raw_bizlog_get_logger).parameters) > 0
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        _BIZLOG_SUPPORTS_NAME = False

    def _bizlog_get_logger(_name: str | None = None) -> logging.Logger:
        if _BIZLOG_SUPPORTS_NAME:
            logger = cast("_BizlogCallable", _raw_bizlog_get_logger)()
        else:
            logger = cast("_BizlogNoArgCallable", _raw_bizlog_get_logger)()

        base_logger = getattr(logger, "_logger", None)
        if isinstance(base_logger, logging.Logger):
            base_logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
        return logger

except ImportError:

    def _bizlog_get_logger(name: str | None = None) -> logging.Logger:
        logger = logging.getLogger(name or __name__)
        if not logger.handlers:
            handler = logging.StreamHandler()
            formatter = logging.Formatter(
                "%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s"
            )
            handler.setFormatter(formatter)
            logger.addHandler(handler)
        logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
        return logger


_ID_PSEUDONYM_PREFIX = "[id:"
_REDACTED_URL = "[redacted-url]"
_REDACTED_PATH = "[redacted-path]"
===
    * privacy redaction filters (UUID, URL, path, object-repr) are attached
      automatically;
    * INFO+ records standardise on the ``dokumentenpruefung`` service name
      (matching the wider log aggregation contract);
    * when ``bizlog`` itself is not installed the wrapper transparently
      falls back to a stdlib logger — so tests in minimal environments and
      cold-start scripts still function.

    DEBUG diagnostic events are enabled here even though the wrapper
    defaults to INFO: this subsystem owns the DEBUG channel for VP
    timeout/perf telemetry. Operators can silence it again via
    ``VP_DIAGNOSTIC_LOGGING=off`` (see
    :func:`is_diagnostic_logging_enabled`).

    Args:
        name: Optional sub-name appended to the diagnostic namespace.

    Returns:
        A logger object compatible with :class:`logging.Logger` (stdlib path)
        or a ``structlog.BoundLogger`` (bizlog path). Both are accepted by
        every helper in this module.
    """
    full_name = (
        _DIAGNOSTIC_LOGGER_NAME if name is None else f"{_DIAGNOSTIC_LOGGER_NAME}.{name}"
    )
    logger = _bizlog_wrapper_get_logger(full_name)
    # Allow DEBUG diagnostic events through; the wrapper pins INFO by default.
    if hasattr(logger, "setLevel"):
        with suppress(AttributeError, TypeError):  # pragma: no cover - structlog quirk
            logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
    backing_logger = getattr(logger, "_logger", None)
    if isinstance(backing_logger, logging.Logger):
        backing_logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
    return logger
